name: [forge-admin] push zone_missed — a wave group was retired unsent
message:
A time-zone group of a campaign was recorded as missed, so those phones never received it. A missed row never consumes the phone's local day, so the next campaign can still reach them.

The line carries reason=late, reason=flag_off, or reason=run_not_alive.
- late: the group's instant passed by more than three hours, which means a worker outage or a deploy that spanned the hour.
- flag_off: PUSH_CAMPAIGNS_ENABLED was set to false mid-wave, which is the intended kill switch.
- run_not_alive: the recovery sweep found a live campaign whose run the runtime no longer holds.

Expected to be flat zero on the first campaign. Read the campaign's report for the missed count per country.
